name: G8_WorldTradeCentre
lede: Arrival in the vertical lobby of the summit.
body:
Motorcades thread up Argyle and Cumberland, a slow choreography of steel and flags.

In the glass atrium the temperature shifts: jacket off, badge on, air thick with protocol.

name: G8_GrandParade
body:
Crowds press along Barrington, media vans parked in a ring, cables looping over the cobbles.

The cenotaph stands between the podium and the line of microphones.

name: G8_Commons
lede: The parking lot and playing fields become a temporary village.
body:
Rows of temporary structures stand where soccer goals used to be.

Generators pulse, cables run under metal ramps, white tents hold accreditation and security.

name: G8_Harbourfront
lede: The summit's edge condition at the waterline.
body:
Delegation dinners occupy the restaurants along the boardwalk.

Security watches the gaps between patios, checking badges against silhouettes.

name: G8_CitadelLookout
lede: Elevated view of the grid during the summit.
body:
From the slope above Brunswick Street, the road closures show up as gaps in the usual flow.

Helicopters mark the airspace, one small circle at a time.

name: G8_RoutePoint
lede: One bend in the motorcade route.
body:
On this corner the wait feels longer than the procession.

Police radios crackle, neighbours stand back from the curb, and then the line of cars arrives all at once.

name: Academy
lede: Top of the fire escape stairs
body:
Stop here. Don't move. The door counts seconds.

The compass is live: your next checkpoint is already marked.

Boopbooop

name: Academy_SideEast
lede: Checkpoint 2 of 4. The fire escape. You are now off the public face.
body:
Iron stairs, three landings. The middle door is propped with a brick — the same brick every time, or always a different one. The emergency system holds a small social life in suspension.

Stand still. The passage resolves in eight seconds.
Next checkpoint: the back lane. Compass heading is south.

name: Academy_BackLane
lede: Checkpoint 3 of 4. The rear of the building. No public face here.
body:
This is what the building actually runs on: a loading bay, a ventilation stack, two cable conduits painted the wrong shade of grey, a drain that smells of the 1970s.

The institution's front is a performance. This is the stage door.

Dwell here. Do not move until the passage locks in.
Your final checkpoint is around the northwest corner.

name: Academy_FrontWest
lede: Checkpoint 4 of 4. The circuit closes here.
body:
The west corner is where the rear lane rejoins the public face. One step around this corner and the maintenance grammar ends; the institutional grammar resumes.

You have walked all four sides. The building has been read.
